# etag_conditional — conditional GET driven by ETag, page_number pagination
# Boots the etag_conditional scenario, runs one drain (probe step + 3 data
# pages), and asserts the trace and events match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml etag_conditional
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
